tracking_assignments._comment: CONSIST DEFINITION: In this system, 'consist' means 1 or more locomotives controlled together. A single locomotive can be tracked as a 'consist of 1' (rear_address = null). This allows unified config/code for both traditional consists (lead + rear) and single locos. Gate tracking (Δt calculation) requires 2 locos AND 2 gates configured. Keys are consist/loco DCC addresses.
